decisionBasis.summary: The maintainer explicitly accepted the new rules, authorized merging PR #115 and directed completion of NF-101 in single-maintainer mode after delegating organizational choices.
decisionBasis.scope: One human review assignment and seven bounded maintenance roles recorded here; not technical review or architecture acceptance.

reviewAssignment.conflictsDeclaration: Sole project maintainer reviewing own project materials; no independent assurance claimed.

supportPolicy.window: At available maintenance sessions; no fixed hours, response deadline, availability guarantee or SLA.
supportPolicy.dependencyUpdates: Review advisories for changed dependencies and before a release, and triage reported risks at the next available maintenance session; no unattended updates or automatic lock changes.
supportPolicy.incidentAuthority: Alexander Agafonov coordinates private triage under SECURITY.md, may stop publication and propose repairs; existing per-operation approval boundaries still apply.
supportPolicy.escalation: Escalate scope, infrastructure, credentials, release and unresolved safety decisions to the same maintainer; no external responder or on-call service is appointed.
supportPolicy.continuityRisk: Maintenance and response can stop when the sole maintainer is unavailable.
supportPolicy.targetSupportClaim: No new accepted product target or lifecycle/signing support claim; evaluation targets are not supported installations.

acceptedObligations: Maintain validation-only repository commands and diagnostics.
Review CLI compatibility and regression evidence; keep runtime execution outside the CLI validation scope.
Maintain pure validation APIs, schema/semantic coverage, fixtures and diagnostic contracts.
Preserve frozen inputs and version mapping; disclose unsupported coverage.
Own future runtime design, effect/authority boundaries and review routing only.
Revisit implementation ownership, production operations and on-call obligations before any runtime implementation or support commitment.
owners.scopeLimit: design-only; implementation and on-call support not offered

acceptedObligations: Coordinate private reporting, security-boundary review, triage and incident follow-up under SECURITY.md.
Retain unresolved risks and stop unsupported acceptance or publication claims; no response SLA or independent certification.
Own dependency/license inventories, advisory triage and reviewed update proposals.
Keep exact locks and provenance; obtain repair scope before changing frozen candidate dependencies.
Maintain CI, immutable verification receipts, artifact checksum/provenance requirements and release checklists.
Require separate release authorization, compatible version decisions and actual target evidence; a green PR is not release readiness.
Coordinate target provisioning, distribution evidence and requests for permitted signing authority.
Keep unavailable keys, certificates, native targets and lifecycle steps blocked/not-tested until separately authorized and verified.
owners.scopeLimit: coordination-only; no certificate, key, notarization or target-provisioning authority supplied

capabilityBlockers: Actual permitted signing identity and authority remain unavailable; ownership is coordination, not signing permission.
Native target, lifecycle, isolation, fidelity, supply-chain and comparable-measurement gaps require their own evidence and review.
A future runtime implementation, production support and on-call service require a new scoped decision.
returnToIndependentReview: Record a new governance transition when another maintainer joins; do not count two review lenses as two people.

authorization.policyPullRequestMerge: PR #115 only, explicitly authorized and completed
